additional_info.subject: ID0426862-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170001959]  Charging Points Fail. CRM:00798002164
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We have investigated the Charger,
We got to see couple of Error Flags as follows:
We need to investigate the QA17 & QA18 contactors. We recommend having spare contactor while site intervention.
Also, For CanCommLoss Error, We need to check for the missing Power converter Serial number and Check for the CAN communication connections.
We need to swap converter with adjacent one and check if issue persists. If so, We need to consider replacing converter. Else, We need to replace the CAN communication cable.
